device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
interpretation: The content-validated path removed torch.unique from the profile. No single sparse scatter dominates: aten::index_add is about 8.8 percent of aggregate self CUDA time, while many small linear, index, elementwise, reduction and einsum kernels contribute. The same-edge gap is therefore primarily a broad fixed launch/feature-stack cost, not evidence that the O(E_local) scatter itself is asymptotically wrong.
optimization_boundary: A fused or compiled production kernel is the next systems target. Profiler timings include instrumentation overhead and must not replace synchronized benchmark medians in scaling-results.json.
